findings.description: The per-chunk debug log prints chunks[0].score for every rank instead of the current chunk's score, so the logged scores for ranks 2..N are wrong.
findings.rationale: Trigger: retrieval returns more than one chunk with differing scores and debug logging is enabled. Mechanism: the format arguments use chunks[0].score rather than chunk.score, so every line reports the top score. Impact: operators reading the logs to diagnose retrieval quality see misleading per-chunk scores; no user-facing output changes.
